question: Can the uninitiated become a complete samayin?
premises: he becomes complete, a well-cultivated samayin
inference: Devotion under Shiva-will-impulse completes without formal initiation.
plain_english: Whoever, though initiation-devoid, impelled by Shiva-will-rite, eats with devotion — complete, he would be a well-cultivated samayin.
